resolution: Root cause was live edit scope surviving a model-document replacement: an old [0,2) range filtered the healthy cylinder part [0,14) down to exactly two adjacent quads and seven unique editable edges. Fresh file/cooked model loads now clear only the prior document scope, while in-document topology edits and quality remeshing retain their scope. Authored face-group arrival now invalidates the native boundary cache; the HUD reports authored/editable edges (36 for this 12-sided cylinder) instead of all 66 render-triangle edges; and Edit History now records live scope plus welded, triangle-edge, and editable-edge counts and flags stale ranges. The exact 24-vertex/14-face/44-triangle cylinder and seven-edge stale-scope failure are covered natively. Mesh-edit and journal tests, ReleaseFast editor build, live headless bridge/log probe, and a silent 60+ second post-init spike trace pass.
